summary: Telnyx's selective startup program offers up to $20,000 in voice-AI credits for 6 months (STT, TTS and LLM inference), plus 3 months of engineering support. Credits cover Voice AI agents, STT/TTS/LLM inference APIs, embeddings and cloud storage, not general call control or other non-AI services. LLM coverage is limited to open-source models running on Telnyx infrastructure: external proprietary models such as GPT-5 can be connected but are not paid for by these credits. Standard pricing applies after credits are exhausted. It targets startups building their own product with a working voice AI agent front and center and a working prototype or clear path to launch. The eligibility heading says 'Raised $500k+ in funding', but its body says 'If you've recently raised or are generating revenue from production users'; confirm eligibility during review rather than treating that ambiguous wording as an unconditional funding minimum. Apply with a company email and product, funding and launch details; accepted startups complete a kickoff before credits are added.
claim_steps: Confirm your product has a working voice AI agent front and center and a working prototype or clear launch path.
Review the funding/revenue criterion: the heading says 'Raised $500k+ in funding', while the body says recently raised or generating production-user revenue. Ask Telnyx to confirm your eligibility.
Apply with a company email and provide product, funding, and launch details.
Wait for review, normally within 48 hours.
If accepted, complete the kickoff so credits can be added to the account. Use credits within 6 months of approval; engineering support lasts 3 months.
Use credits for Voice AI agents, STT/TTS/LLM inference, embeddings and cloud storage, not general call control or other non-AI services.
For LLM inference, credits cover only open-source models running on Telnyx infrastructure; external proprietary models such as GPT-5 are not credit-covered.
Monitor the balance: standard pricing follows credit exhaustion, and unused credits do not roll over after the 6-month expiry.
